title: feat(orders): list orders with the customer name
description: The orders page needs the customer name next to each order. Adds `listOrdersWithCustomer`, which returns the page of orders with `customerName` (null when the customer was deleted).
rationale: One `findOne` on `customers` per order in a loop of up to 200 orders: an N+1, where one `$in` query (or a `$lookup`) does it.

extras.note: the accountId filter of the customer lookup is the tenant isolation and no test fails if it is dropped
same point as orders.ts:38, anchored on the test: no customer of another account in the fixtures
a loop over [] returns []: no branch to test; the points bundled with it (field passthrough, same customer, PAGE_SIZE inherited from listOrders) do not hold either
tests a batched Map/$in path that does not exist in this diff; it belongs with the N+1 fix, not as a finding on the loop
`OrderWithCustomer extends Order`: tsc fails if the spread is dropped, and the [null, 'Ada'] assertion already pins the order
